1991. Multiple Exception Handler

90

Hard

Problem Statement

Given two values intended to be integers, divide the first by the second. Handle both invalid numeric input and division by zero using multiple catch blocks.

Description

Read two lines of text, x and y, that are expected to represent integers. Inside a single try block, convert both to integers and divide x by y. Use one catch block to handle the case where either value is not a valid integer, and a separate catch block to handle division by zero.

Description

Read two lines of text, x and y, that are expected to represent integers. Inside a single try block, convert both to integers and divide x by y. Use one catch block to handle the case where either value is not a valid integer, and a separate catch block to handle division by zero.

Input Description

Two lines, each containing a string: x and y.
output_spec: If both values are valid integers and y is not zero, print the quotient of x divided by y. If either value is not a valid integer, print "Error: Invalid number format". If y is zero, print "Error: Division by zero not allowed".
